GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2013-05-01T19:49:21Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Model.save() with options and no key/val
Description: Using backbone 1.0.0.

I have not been able to figure out how to call Model.save and pass options (success, error) and have it skip the key/val logic.

What I've done for now is override Model.save changing the following line (50) in from:
      if (key == null || typeof key === 'object') {
To:
      if (key === null || typeof key === 'object') {

This allows me to call save as Model.save(undefined, undefined, {succes: mySuccess, error: myError}); and not have the options wiped out in the parameter logic of save.

Maybe there is another way around this but I was unable to find it.
